title: RBC Royal Bank Open new branch in Mississauga
description: This Video Created by Aljaleya Media [PHONE]  Share our news on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/aljaleya.ca  For more news, visit our website  www.aljaleya.ca  To watch the other videos of the Caesar party, visit our channel  http://aljaleya.ca/aljaleyacanel.html

asr.full_text: In Mississauga city, another branch is opened for it to provide services to our customers in the Arab society. the most exciting part of my job is opening new branches that tells us we're growing, our communities are growing and it's exciting times for all And with the grand opening for us, it's very much to say ''Thank You'' to the community that we support in welcoming us here at Parkside village and also toulated the team What is important to mention that The Royal Bank was donated to be financed financially by CVC To maintain climate cleanliness This in addition to the budget provided for services with an outstanding offer Where you can use your iPad with new account which offers it a monthly subscription We wish for this budget a good development and growth It's good for us to thank to the Arab team as well monthly subscription price. In this bank's case we wish additional advancement and prosperity. We are glad to give thanks to the Arabian staff who are working for this bank and who provide services for Arabian members in their mother tongue. Again greetings to the management of the department who helped us in the planning of this project. So I gotta tell you, every time I go around with one of these chacks, I'm being guaranteed to ask do you really cash that? We do have a real check for Karen here, but eh... Speaker 5 All right, Mr. McDonald it's nice to see you here again, I just have a couple questions for ya. How do you feel the generous donation to the CYC will affect the community in Mississauga and the environment? Speaker 3 Well for us it's more of a piece. Along the way to help support the community the donation of creating the awareness is key. Especially with our Credit Valley Watershed in supporting it, but also its the other things too. Its just creating awareness to ensure we as a community are actively involved in supporting with various activities around education, and also clean cleanup and all that that goes with it. In fact the Team was out just earlier this week involved in a cleanup. So, Y'see, Awesome! With this beautiful brand new branch and all the new technology, Basically it's gonna change the way people look at RBC especially in this community. Do you think this is ain stone for RBC? Yes it's one, it's a journey we've been on. We've been on it for quite some time. And kind of creating a retail environment in our store. So you will notice if you look around it's a very open concept. There's alot of, that you have touched on, alot of the interactive technology. It's more just making it more comfortable for our clients to to join us in trying to make our branches a better fit from within our communities Well Mr. Mcdonalds thank you for being here it's a pleasure to meet you again Thank you We are in the heart of Mississauga. Good evening! Welcome. Please tell us about your great branch that you opened and that will support the Arabic community because we see that many jobs are Arabic. How do you feel about this new opening? First of all, we are very happy that we are here and in this place because because of course our employees have languages like Hindi, Arabic and Portuguese that can be used to serve the people here. And the main thing is that we can especially help people and newcomers who have a language barrier that is difficult for them to explain or have a personal understanding of how they used the banking process in their countries We are happy to be working in this new branch A lot of people are coming to us and we're very happy to be part of the company We opened a branch in November, but it was only a soft opening We built our clientele with this branch and as you can see now, they're all coming with us, as they are really happy to have us here. Especially with the wide Arabic community in Mississauga I wish to be successful, especially to you the Arab community Anything is available to you Thank you for your support and support of the Arab community that we have here along with RBC and across Canada, but also with the Blue Water Project and various other charitable organizations across the GTA and across Canada. With RBC's generous donation to the CVCF, where are these funds going to be directed to? Awesome. Really good question. So the Credit Valley Conservation Foundation supports the work of the Credit Valley Conservation, which is an organization that protects land and water in the Credit River watershed, where we are today, the main river that flows through Brampton Orangeville Mississauga all the way to Lake Ontario and the program that I coordinate is called the conservation youth core program and so the RBC blue water fund $10,000 is going towards that program and this CYC this program helps get youth into nature and gives them real life, real working skills. It might be their first job that they've ever had. And we train them to work outside safely, and then we take them to work. Nice. Yeah. That's awesome. Thank you very much for being here. Thank you for representing this awesome foundation, and thanks for all the work you're doing. Have a good day. Enjoy your day. You know what? I'm so excited. I've been waiting for this day. I mean, this is a perfect location and I've been with RBC. I'm so excited about this branch opening. We have a fantastic location and we are so proud to be here to share our services for our community. So I'm really, really excited. I feel very happy because we're going to help the whole community we have elderly people. They are very close to our place and we have lots of new immigrants as well Thank you for opening this new branch and it's beautiful Thanks Thank you for opening this branch in it's beautiful. Have a good one. Because it is closer to us, we are partners at PSV So we support the grand opening day And they support us with all our banking needs as well What is the concept of banking? Thank you so much for allowing us to speak here The Retail by Design concept Is very much like an Apple store If you go into an Apple store and everything is... you've got salespeople on the floor interacting with clients and you have the technology that the clients can actually touch and learn about our products and services right on our desktops. So, the premise is that we are interacting with the clients all the time, when they come into our store. And we're showing retail behaviors, meaning we're asking them, how can we help them? How can we give them the right advice? And only when an account manager sees a client is actually when they come into the office, because otherwise because otherwise we are out there, we are communicating and of course interacting consistently with our clients that's the ideology of the department doesn't have a office. The goal is that the head has to work behind a wall in the back of the office and can't be met. On the other hand, in retail by design De novo branch, like Parkside Village, the first person to be met is usually the branch manager. And the last number will be the manager. So all the time, we are always available whenever a client needs us. The whole concept of having a manager behind closed doors she is not approachable or he is not approachable so...this is very much hand on like as managers, we are a co-team we're teams and everything is hands-on if you need, I can deposit a cheque for you I can do a mortgage for you and I can solve problems for you do an investment for you that and I can solve problems for you, do investment for you. That's just the way it is. Not that I do that as often as they call that… Let's talk about a friendly team. Yes, yes! Thank you. Just one more question. Yes, but I would like to quote what Susana said, and Im just going to add onto what you just said, which is that in this branch, we are not just stuck in the label of manager. Because we have customer service representatives, because a branch can be used without a manager So, if we have customer service representatives, if they are not in charge, we would be far behind and we become in charge That's how we manage everything location we are very multilingual and before we actually opened the branch and we were doing our interviews sometime in October we always had it in in our minds that we needed to represent the community where we were in that was very important so everybody here at this location actually speaks a second language myself included I speak Portuguese, we have our Arabic we have two staff that speak Arabic we are South Asian languages we have we have somebody from the Philippines that speaks obviously their their dialect and their language we haven't Vietnamese and we just hired a new individual who is speaks Ethiopian and Greek so it's a it's an international and I have we do have two partners that speak Mandarin and Cantonese and then yes the Punjabi or do Hindi all the South Asian languages as well Added to that one of our part of the suspects for a seat so I'm just not yes yes persian and French I've met speaks French say services yes he gets yes how you got a chance for your idea maybe not good and how's home but I have time and is it 100 more on it didn't look at it is that at a time to respect by because our university was able to bring these students to the local universities there. Exactly. They send them an information about the communities in these areas. So, we are here to interview the staff members. Our goal is to ensure staff and students have the means to bring these students to these schools but we can't cover all the languages in this region. However, we will continue to improve our abilities as we grow We are in the name of the Arab Community and we would like to thank you for your work We hope to help for your interests We want to help not only the Arab community but all other communities Thank you so much for having me. Thank you for being here. Thank you very much, thank you.
